comment: Trigger-routing query set for Level T. Split 60/40: guide description edits with TRAIN failures only; HOLDOUT is the headline accuracy. Never copy a failing query's keywords into a description (agentskills.io overfitting rule). Ported from docs/evals/trigger-eval.md 2026-08-22 round (P1-P6, N1-N6) + 8 new holdout queries.
